title: pultenaea stricta var. gunnii
intro: Pultenaea stricta var. gunnii, commonly known as Gunn's bush pea or Gunn's pea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pultenaea stricta var. gunnii include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe and calm irritated skin and reduce the risk of infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
